name: io.github.DasRed/hetzner-mcp
title: Hetzner Cloud
description: Query Hetzner Cloud servers, networks, IPs, volumes, DNS and prices. Read-only by default.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Port mapping host:container. The URL below assumes host port 3000.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: "Bearer <token>", only needed when MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is set

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hetzner Cloud API token of one project, a Read token is enough in read-only mode

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_STORAGE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Separate token for Storage Boxes, falls back to HETZNER_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SPLITS
environmentVariables.description: all or a comma separated list of servers, networking, load-balancers, ips, storage, storage-boxes, config, dns

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated tool names to keep, * as wildcard

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLS_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated tool names to remove, * as wildcard

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: If set, the MCP endpoint requires Authorization: Bearer <token>
